@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+"""Stream diagnostics for distinguishing unusable sinks."""
+
+import typing as t
+
+
+def checked_binary_writer(stream: t.IO[t.Any]) -> bool:
+    """Determine whether ``stream`` writes bytes.
+
+    Works like :func:`click._compat._is_binary_writer`, except that a
+    :exc:`TypeError` is raised when both write probes fail instead of
+    returning a default value.
+    """
+    try:
+        stream.write(b"")
+    except Exception:
+        try:
+            stream.write("")
+            return False
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        raise TypeError(f"{stream!r} is not usable as a binary or text writer")
+    return True
